title: Recording Output Delegate Deadlock Fix
requirements: Replace the continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>? mutable field in RecordingOutputDelegate with isolated state behind a Mutex<DelegateState> (Swift 6.0 synchronization) or a single-threaded actor mailbox; remove the @unchecked Sendable annotation — type-system-enforced safety only

Order the frame explicitly: output.stopRecording() must invoke didFinishRecordingTo / captureError on a background thread; the delegate stores the result before waitForCompletion() can await the continuation — robust to delivery order (callback fires before or after the continuation is installed)

Implement pre-resume: if didFinishRecordingTo fires before waitForCompletion enters, store the completion state up front and let the next waitForCompletion resume immediately from the stored state rather than awaiting a continuation nobody will resume

Remove the @MainActor annotation on waitForCompletion (or any cross-actor hop) — the method should run inside the AudioRecorder actor and not require a MainActor hop, since AVFoundation callbacks do not target the main thread
The captureError and continuation fields must not be mutated concurrently from different threads without synchronization
acceptance_criteria: 50 sequential start()→stop() cycles complete in <2 seconds each with no hang
swift test --sanitize=thread is clean — no Thread Sanitizer warnings on RecordingOutputDelegate
The callback can fire before or after waitForCompletion enters without hanging
out_of_scope: Changing the recording format or .m4a container
